spec_case: issue #516 (M1-K2): the same locked profile, with routing.respect_explicit: false
description: The router wins despite the run-level lock: model_reason: "router", model becomes the scored band's model. A second prompt, ask_explicit, sets its own model: directly (no run-level lock involved) and is routed the same way, since respect_explicit: false overrides a prompt's own explicit model just as it overrides the run-level lock.
